chunks: And from him (Al-Hassan ibn Ma'sum) from Al-Qasim from Ali from Abu Basir
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Nahwahu' indicate in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* confirms the consistency of the chain of transmission (isnad) through Abu Basir, a prominent companion of Imam al-Sadiq, regarding the permissible number of wives. It serves to reinforce the juristic consensus on polygyny by linking this report directly to the preceding authoritative texts in the chapter, ensuring the legal ruling is grounded in multiple reliable sources.
